title: On the Complexity of Preference-Based Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2609.39351v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study preference-based bandits with general reward function classes, where a learner sequentially selects pairs of arms and observes binary preference feedback governed by the Bradley--Terry model. This setting naturally arises in applications such as recommender systems, tournament ranking, and learning from human feedback, where relative preferences are easier to elicit than absolute rewards. The observation model inherits the logistic bandit challenge of handling the problem-dependent constant $\kappa$, which accounts for the non-linearity of the link function and can grow arbitrarily large. Moreover, prior work has predominantly focused on linear or kernelized reward models, precluding the use of richer function classes. To address these limitations, we consider general reward function classes and introduce the \emph{locally sensitive eluder dimension}, a novel complexity measure tailored to the logistic structure of preference fe

translated_title: 基于偏好的老虎机问题的复杂度研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有一般奖励函数类的基于偏好的老虎机问题，其中学习者依次选择臂对，并观察由 Bradley--Terry 模型支配的二元偏好反馈。这一设定自然出现在推荐系统、锦标赛排名以及从人类反馈中学习等应用场景中，因为在这些场景下，相对偏好比绝对奖励更容易获取。该观测模型继承了逻辑斯蒂老虎机中处理依赖于问题的常数 $\kappa$ 的挑战，该常数反映了链接函数的非线性，并且可以任意增大。此外，先前的工作主要集中于线性或核化的奖励模型，无法使用更丰富的函数类。为了解决这些局限性，我们考虑一般的奖励函数类，并引入了“局部敏感逃逸维度”，这是一种专为偏好反馈的逻辑斯蒂结构设计的新型复杂度度量。
tldr: 该论文提出“局部敏感逃逸维度”这一新型复杂度度量，用于分析具有一般奖励函数类的基于偏好的老虎机问题，克服了逻辑斯蒂常数 $\kappa$ 带来的挑战以及以往工作仅限于线性或核化模型的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the locally sensitive eluder dimension, a novel complexity measure for preference-based bandits with general reward function classes, overcoming the challenge of the problem-dependent logistic constant κ and the limitations of prior work restricted to linear or kernelized models.
